cohort: 104 infertile women with at least a 1-year history of infertility and submucosal myomas as the only cause of infertility
finding: Resectoscopic myomectomy resulted in an 85.8% pregnancy rate in infertile women with submucosal myomas, with no significant differences in pregnancy, delivery, or caesarean section rates based on myoma classification, size, location, or number.
